title: Building and Fire – Property Hazard Classification – January 2023
description: Appellants applied for a building permit for premises storing and tinting paint and similar products in small containers, classified as Group F, Division 2 medium-hazard by their Professional Engineer and code consultant's Code Review Report. The appellants argued that 'bulk storage' and 'sufficient quantity' are undefined, that small containers are not bulk storage, and that tinting is comparable to retail paint mixing.

refusal.basis: close analog: permit refused under Div C 2.2.10.8.(2)(b) ('information submitted is inadequate to determine compliance'); not a variance-form refusal

outcome_summary: Refusal confirmed for inadequate information given a potential special fire hazard. The tribunal pointed to a variance under NBC(AE) 2019 Div C 2.3.1.1 as a possible route.
